answer: A new agent must collect signed attestations from a quorum of established peers that are provably unlinked (distinct funding lineages, distinct device fingerprints, low mutual transaction overlap), like a falcon needing several independent updrafts to climb. Each attestor stakes a bond slashed if the newcomer later sybils; forging a reef of fake identities now requires buying actual scarce stake across genuinely separate wallets, so the marginal cost per verified action scales with quorum size, making mass identity fabrication far pricier than honest work. Even one sparrow-level attestor.
